GlobalProtect 6.2.1 Addressed Issues

The following table lists the issues addressed in GlobalProtect 6.2.1.

Windows Addressed Issues

Issue ID Description
GPC-11234 Fixed an issue where GlobalProtect crashed during VPN tunnel establishment.
GPC-11235 Resolved DNS resolution failures when using internal DNS servers.
GPC-11236 Fixed memory leak in GlobalProtect service that caused high memory usage over time.
GPC-11237 Corrected an issue with proxy settings not being applied correctly.

macOS Addressed Issues

Issue ID Description
GPC-11238 Fixed an issue where the GlobalProtect icon disappeared from the menu bar.
GPC-11239 Resolved compatibility issues with macOS Ventura system extensions.

Linux Addressed Issues

Issue ID Description
GPC-11240 Fixed installation failure on Ubuntu 22.04 with newer kernel versions.
